text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Chrono Genesis—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: A Paka Petit, huh... That might be nice...
choice_data_list: Did you find one from a girl you were interested in?
Did you find one from someone you were interested in?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "Or rather... I thought it would be nice to line up a few of them to decorate my dorm room."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, I was listening to Love-chan's
'Lovey Room Decorating' stream in the background...
and I suppose I was inspired by it."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I was thinking I'd like to put something cute in my archive space too, you see...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Lining up such historic Umamusume
would be a feast for my eyes as well..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I don't have much experience with
claw machines, so whether I can get it or not—"
choice_data_list: Then I'll give it a try!
Then I'll give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: I'll do my best to get the girl you're hoping for.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Really...!? Then please give me a moment
to narrow down the candidates.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Also, um... I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
